beats.line: Okay so here's the thing about creativity
Waiting around for inspiration to strike — that's a terrible strategy
You can't build anything reliable on maybe I'll feel inspired today
The truth is creativity isn't some magic spark that just happens to you
And once you know the system you can force it on demand whenever you need it
Here are six ways to do that
Number one: give yourself a no-stimulation morning
Here's what I mean. For the first thirty to sixty minutes after you wake up
don't touch your phone, don't turn on the TV, nothing
